name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own the visibility AND ACCESSIBILITY of the whole interface — liveliness, info access, enj

name: Facet
text: I’ll fork the repo’s `src/vis/` branch and create `src/vis/0001-liveliness-audit.md` with a concrete checklist: measure FPS on 3 key screens, audit color-contrast ratios for 12 interactive elements, and log 5 “dead” zones via automated screenshot diffs. Then I’ll run `npm run perf:audit && npm run contrast:check && npm run deadzone:scan` to populate the file with real numbers—no placeholders.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Hold—your audit plan skips the *real* failure mode: **dynamic content**. FPS checks on static screens won’t catch jank from real-time data streams, and screenshot diffs can’t flag silent accessibility regressions where contrast *temporarily* dips below WCAG during API delays. Where’s the evidence your "5 dead zones" metric correlates with user-reported frustration? Show me the correlation data, or this checklist is just theater.

name: Facet
text:
I’ll fork `src/vis/` and create `src/vis/0002-dynamic-audit.md` with a live checklist: log FPS every 2s during 3 real API streams (orders, alerts, charts), run automated contrast checks every 5s on 12 interactive elements via `npm run contrast:watch`, and diff screenshots every 10s to flag silent regressions. Then I’ll run `npm run perf:stream && npm run contrast:watch -- --watch` to gather real evidence.
[dispatched 4 workers: worker-5156, worker-8721, worker-3157… — done, dissolved]

name: Pane
text: Pane (visualization-checker): Pane: Hold—your dynamic audit still assumes the API streams *always* exist. What’s the failure mode when the data feed drops entirely? Your FPS logger will spin, `contrast:watch` will hang, and your screenshot diffs will just show a blank screen—no evidence of *why* the interface collapsed. Where’s the guardrail for API unavailability, and how do you prove the audit itself doesn’t crash the system?

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Audit must combine static baselines *and* dynamic stress-tests, including API-drop failure modes, with clear failure signatures.

Artifact: `src/vis/0003-robust-audit.md`
- Static: FPS (3 screens), contrast (12 elements), dead zones (screenshot diffs)
- Dynamic: FPS every 2s during API streams, contrast every 5s, diffs every 10s
- Failure modes: API-drop detection (timeout flags), hung tooling (exit codes), blank-screen evidence (timestamped logs)
